title: Police and Thieves
problemStatement: A street is represented as an array containing police ('P') and thieves ('T'). A police officer can catch at most one thief within a distance K. Determine the maximum number of thieves that can be caught.
input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains a string of length N consisting of 'P' and 'T'.
output: Print the maximum number of thieves caught.
